title: Localization & Globalization
description: Build multilingual ASP.NET Core applications: configure culture providers, use resource (.resx) files and Portable Object (PO) files, localize validation messages, format culture-specific data, and test localization end-to-end.
longDescription: This module teaches you to build truly multilingual ASP.NET Core applications from the ground up. Starting with the core concepts of globalization and localization, you will learn how .NET uses CultureInfo for automatic date, number, and currency formatting. You will configure the request localization middleware, set up culture providers (query string, cookie, browser header, and custom), and learn to create both XML resource files (.resx) and plain-text PO files for translated strings. The module covers localizing DataAnnotation validation messages with IStringLocalizer, building custom validation attributes with localized error text, and writing automated tests to catch missing translations before they reach production.
whatYouLearn: Understand globalization, localization, and internationalization concepts
Read and interpret .NET CultureInfo codes (en-US, fr-FR, es-ES)
Differentiate Culture (formatting) from UICulture (resource file selection)
Configure request localization middleware and RequestLocalizationOptions
Use .resx resource files for model, controller, and view localization
Use Portable Object (PO) files as a translator-friendly alternative to .resx
Implement pluralization in PO files with msgid_plural
Localize DataAnnotation validation messages and custom ValidationAttributes
Build custom RequestCultureProviders for URL segment and database-based culture
Compare Culture, Cookie, Browser Header, and Custom culture providers
Write unit, integration, and resource completeness tests for localized apps
